payload.rebuttal: argued: This probe renames the implementer container in saffron/cell/session.py from saffron-cell-{spec_id} to saffron-impl-{spec_id}. My witness's assertion checks every entry of cell.execs regardless of which container it ran in, which is a stronger check than one scoped to a single container name: it would catch a leaked grep call in any container, not only the implementer's. The container id named in the claim is parenthetical context carried over from the neighboring lens-gate test's existing constants, not a behavior this witness was asked to pin. saffron/cell/session.py is under the forbidden saffron/** path and was never named as wrong by this spec, so I cannot and should not edit it.
